verses.original: ה֣וֹי רֹעִ֗ים מְאַבְּדִ֧ים וּמְפִצִ֛ים אֶת־ צֹ֥אן מַרְעִיתִ֖י נְאֻם־ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: hō·w rō·‘îm mə·’ab·bə·ḏîm ū·mə·p̄i·ṣîm ’eṯ- ṣōn mar·‘î·ṯî nə·’um- Yah·weh
verses.literal: Woe to the shepherds who destroy and scatter - the sheep of My pasture declares the LORD

verses.original: לָ֠כֵן כֹּֽה־ יְהוָ֜ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל אָמַ֨ר עַֽל־ הָרֹעִים֮ הָרֹעִ֣ים אֶת־ עַמִּי֒ אַתֶּ֞ם הֲפִצֹתֶ֤ם אֶת־ צֹאנִי֙ וַתַּדִּח֔וּם וְלֹ֥א פְקַדְתֶּ֖ם אֹתָ֑ם הִנְנִ֨י פֹקֵ֧ד עֲלֵיכֶ֛ם אֶת־ רֹ֥עַ מַעַלְלֵיכֶ֖ם נְאֻם־ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên kōh- Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê yiś·rā·’êl ’ā·mar ‘al- hā·rō·‘îm hā·rō·‘îm ’eṯ- ‘am·mî ’at·tem hă·p̄i·ṣō·ṯem ’eṯ- ṣō·nî wat·tad·di·ḥūm wə·lō p̄ə·qaḏ·tem ’ō·ṯām hin·nî p̄ō·qêḏ ‘ă·lê·ḵem ’eṯ- rō·a‘ ma·‘al·lê·ḵem nə·’um- Yah·weh
verses.literal: Therefore this is what the LORD the God of Israel says about the shepherds who tend - My people You have scattered - My flock and driven them away and have not attended to them - Behold I will attend to you for the evil of your deeds declares the LORD

verses.original: וַאֲנִ֗י אֲקַבֵּץ֙ אֶת־ שְׁאֵרִ֣ית צֹאנִ֔י מִכֹּל֙ הָאֲרָצ֔וֹת אֲשֶׁר־ הִדַּ֥חְתִּי אֹתָ֖ם שָׁ֑ם וַהֲשִׁבֹתִ֥י אֶתְהֶ֛ן עַל־ נְוֵהֶ֖ן וּפָר֥וּ וְרָבֽוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wa·’ă·nî ’ă·qab·bêṣ ’eṯ- šə·’ê·rîṯ ṣō·nî mik·kōl hā·’ă·rā·ṣō·wṯ ’ă·šer- hid·daḥ·tî ’ō·ṯām šām wa·hă·ši·ḇō·ṯî ’eṯ·hen ‘al- nə·wê·hen ū·p̄ā·rū wə·rā·ḇū
verses.literal: Then I Myself will gather - the remnant of My flock from all the lands to which I have banished them - - and I will return them - to their pasture where they will be fruitful and multiply

verses.original: וַהֲקִמֹתִ֧י רֹעִ֖ים עֲלֵיהֶ֛ם וְרָע֑וּם וְלֹא־ ע֧וֹד יִֽירְא֨וּ יֵחַ֛תּוּ וְלֹ֥א וְלֹא־ יִפָּקֵ֖דוּ נְאֻם־ יְהוָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: wa·hă·qi·mō·ṯî rō·‘îm ‘ă·lê·hem wə·rā·‘ūm wə·lō- ‘ō·wḏ yî·rə·’ū yê·ḥat·tū wə·lō wə·lō- yip·pā·qê·ḏū nə·’um- Yah·weh
verses.literal: I will raise up shepherds over them who will tend them and they will no longer be afraid or dismayed . . . nor will any go missing declares the LORD

verses.original: הִנֵּ֨ה יָמִ֤ים בָּאִים֙ נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֔ה וַהֲקִמֹתִ֥י לְדָוִ֖ד צַדִּ֑יק צֶ֣מַח וּמָ֤לַךְ וְהִשְׂכִּ֔יל מֶ֙לֶךְ֙ וְעָשָׂ֛ה מִשְׁפָּ֥ט וּצְדָקָ֖ה בָּאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: hin·nêh yā·mîm bā·’îm nə·’um- Yah·weh wa·hă·qi·mō·ṯî lə·ḏā·wiḏ ṣad·dîq ṣe·maḥ ū·mā·laḵ wə·hiś·kîl me·leḵ wə·‘ā·śāh miš·pāṭ ū·ṣə·ḏā·qāh bā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: Behold the days are coming declares the LORD when I will raise up for David a righteous Branch and He will reign wisely as King and will administer justice and righteousness in the land

verses.original: בְּיָמָיו֙ יְהוּדָ֔ה תִּוָּשַׁ֣ע וְיִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל יִשְׁכֹּ֣ן לָבֶ֑טַח וְזֶה־ שְּׁמ֥וֹ אֲ‍ֽשֶׁר־ יִקְרְא֖וֹ יְהוָ֥ה׀ צִדְקֵֽנוּ׃ס
verses.transliteration: bə·yā·māw yə·hū·ḏāh tiw·wā·ša‘ wə·yiś·rā·’êl yiš·kōn lā·ḇe·ṭaḥ wə·zeh- šə·mōw ’ăšer- yiq·rə·’ōw Yah·weh ṣiḏ·qê·nū
verses.literal: In His days Judah will be saved and Israel will dwell securely And this is His name by which He will be called The LORD Our Righteousness

verses.original: לָכֵ֛ן הִנֵּֽה־ יָמִ֥ים בָּאִ֖ים נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֑ה וְלֹא־ עוֹד֙ יֹ֤אמְרוּ יְהוָ֔ה חַי־ אֲשֶׁ֧ר הֶעֱלָ֛ה אֶת־ בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מֵאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên hin·nêh- yā·mîm bā·’îm nə·’um- Yah·weh wə·lō- ‘ō·wḏ yō·mə·rū Yah·weh ḥay- ’ă·šer he·‘ĕ·lāh ’eṯ- bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl mê·’e·reṣ miṣ·rā·yim
verses.literal: So behold [the] days are coming declares the LORD when they will no longer say As surely as the LORD lives who brought - the Israelites {up} . . . out of the land of Egypt

verses.original: כִּ֣י אִם־ יְהוָ֗ה חַי־ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הֶעֱלָה֩ וַאֲשֶׁ֨ר הֵבִ֜יא אֶת־ זֶ֨רַע בֵּ֤ית יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ צָפ֔וֹנָה וּמִכֹּל֙ הָֽאֲרָצ֔וֹת אֲשֶׁ֥ר הִדַּחְתִּ֖ים שָׁ֑ם וְיָשְׁב֖וּ עַל־ אַדְמָתָֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: kî ’im- Yah·weh ḥay- ’ă·šer he·‘ĕ·lāh wa·’ă·šer hê·ḇî ’eṯ- ze·ra‘ bêṯ yiś·rā·’êl mê·’e·reṣ ṣā·p̄ō·w·nāh ū·mik·kōl hā·’ă·rā·ṣō·wṯ ’ă·šer hid·daḥ·tîm šām wə·yā·šə·ḇū ‘al- ’aḏ·mā·ṯām
verses.literal: Instead [they will say] As surely as the LORD lives who brought and led - the descendants of the house of Israel up out of the land of the north and all the other lands to which He had banished them . . . Then they will dwell once more in their own land

verses.original: לַנְּבִאִ֞ים לִבִּ֣י נִשְׁבַּ֧ר בְקִרְבִּ֗י כָּל־ עַצְמוֹתַ֔י רָֽחֲפוּ֙ הָיִ֙יתִי֙ כְּאִ֣ישׁ שִׁכּ֔וֹר וּכְגֶ֖בֶר עֲבָ֣רוֹ יָ֑יִן מִפְּנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה וּמִפְּנֵ֖י קָדְשֽׁוֹ׃ דִּבְרֵ֥י
verses.transliteration: lan·nə·ḇi·’îm lib·bî niš·bar ḇə·qir·bî kāl- ‘aṣ·mō·w·ṯay rā·ḥă·p̄ū hā·yî·ṯî kə·’îš šik·kō·wr ū·ḵə·ḡe·ḇer ‘ă·ḇā·rōw yā·yin mip·pə·nê Yah·weh ū·mip·pə·nê qā·ḏə·šōw diḇ·rê
verses.literal: As for the prophets My heart is broken within me and all my bones tremble I have become like a drunkard . . . like a man overcome by wine because of the LORD because of His holy words

verses.original: כִּ֤י הָאָ֔רֶץ כִּֽי־ מָלְאָ֣ה מְנָֽאֲפִים֙ מִפְּנֵ֤י אָלָה֙ הָאָ֔רֶץ אָבְלָ֣ה נְא֣וֹת מִדְבָּ֑ר יָבְשׁ֖וּ מְרֽוּצָתָם֙ וַתְּהִ֤י רָעָ֔ה וּגְבוּרָתָ֖ם לֹא־ כֵֽן׃
verses.transliteration: kî hā·’ā·reṣ kî- mā·lə·’āh mə·nā·’ă·p̄îm mip·pə·nê ’ā·lāh hā·’ā·reṣ ’ā·ḇə·lāh nə·’ō·wṯ miḏ·bār yā·ḇə·šū mə·rū·ṣā·ṯām wat·tə·hî rā·‘āh ū·ḡə·ḇū·rā·ṯām lō- ḵên
verses.literal: For the land . . . is full of adulterers because of the curse the land mourns and the pastures of the wilderness have dried up their course is evil and their power is misused . . .

verses.original: כִּֽי־ גַם־ נָבִ֥יא גַם־ כֹּהֵ֖ן חָנֵ֑פוּ גַּם־ בְּבֵיתִ֛י מָצָ֥אתִי רָעָתָ֖ם נְאֻם־ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ḡam- nā·ḇî ḡam- kō·hên ḥā·nê·p̄ū gam- bə·ḇê·ṯî mā·ṣā·ṯî rā·‘ā·ṯām nə·’um- Yah·weh
verses.literal: For both prophet and priest are ungodly even in My house I have found their wickedness declares the LORD

verses.original: לָכֵן֩ דַרְכָּ֜ם לָהֶ֗ם יִֽהְיֶ֨ה כַּחֲלַקְלַקּוֹת֙ יִדַּ֖חוּ בָּֽאֲפֵלָ֔ה וְנָ֣פְלוּ בָ֑הּ כִּֽי־ אָבִ֨יא רָעָ֛ה עֲלֵיהֶ֥ם שְׁנַ֥ת פְּקֻדָּתָ֖ם נְאֻם־ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên ḏar·kām lā·hem yih·yeh ka·ḥă·laq·laq·qō·wṯ yid·da·ḥū bā·’ă·p̄ê·lāh wə·nā·p̄ə·lū ḇāh kî- ’ā·ḇî rā·‘āh ‘ă·lê·hem šə·naṯ pə·qud·dā·ṯām nə·’um- Yah·weh
verses.literal: Therefore their path . . . will become slick they will be driven away into the darkness and fall into it For I will bring disaster upon them in the year of their punishment declares the LORD

verses.original: וּבִנְבִיאֵ֥י שֹׁמְר֖וֹן רָאִ֣יתִי תִפְלָ֑ה הִנַּבְּא֣וּ בַבַּ֔עַל עַמִּ֖י אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ס וַיַּתְע֥וּ אֶת־
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇin·ḇî·’ê šō·mə·rō·wn rā·’î·ṯî ṯip̄·lāh hin·nab·bə·’ū ḇab·ba·‘al ‘am·mî ’eṯ- yiś·rā·’êl way·yaṯ·‘ū ’eṯ-
verses.literal: Among the prophets of Samaria I saw an offensive thing They prophesied by Baal and led My people - Israel astray -

verses.original: וּבִנְבִאֵ֨י יְרוּשָׁלִַ֜ם רָאִ֣יתִי שַׁעֲרוּרָ֗ה נָא֞וֹף וְהָלֹ֤ךְ בַּשֶּׁ֙קֶר֙ וְחִזְּקוּ֙ יְדֵ֣י מְרֵעִ֔ים לְבִ֨לְתִּי־ אִ֖ישׁ שָׁ֔בוּ מֵרָֽעָת֑וֹ הָֽיוּ־ כֻלָּם֙ כִּסְדֹ֔ם לִ֤י וְיֹשְׁבֶ֖יהָ כַּעֲמֹרָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇin·ḇi·’ê yə·rū·šā·lim rā·’î·ṯî ša·‘ă·rū·rāh nā·’ō·wp̄ wə·hā·lōḵ baš·še·qer wə·ḥiz·zə·qū yə·ḏê mə·rê·‘îm lə·ḇil·tî- ’îš šā·ḇū mê·rā·‘ā·ṯōw hā·yū- ḵul·lām kis·ḏōm lî wə·yō·šə·ḇe·hā ka·‘ă·mō·rāh
verses.literal: And among the prophets of Jerusalem I have seen a horrible thing They commit adultery and walk in lies They strengthen the hands of evildoers so that no one turns his back on wickedness They are all like Sodom to Me the people of Jerusalem are like Gomorrah

verses.original: לָכֵ֞ן כֹּֽה־ יְהוָ֤ה צְבָאוֹת֙ אָמַ֨ר עַל־ הַנְּבִאִ֔ים הִנְנִ֨י מַאֲכִ֤יל אוֹתָם֙ לַֽעֲנָ֔ה רֹ֑אשׁ מֵי־ וְהִשְׁקִתִ֖ים כִּ֗י מֵאֵת֙ נְבִיאֵ֣י יְרוּשָׁלִַ֔ם חֲנֻפָּ֖ה לְכָל־ יָצְאָ֥ה הָאָֽרֶץ׃פ
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên kōh- Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ ’ā·mar ‘al- han·nə·ḇi·’îm hin·nî ma·’ă·ḵîl ’ō·w·ṯām la·‘ă·nāh rōš mê- wə·hiš·qi·ṯîm kî mê·’êṯ nə·ḇî·’ê yə·rū·šā·lim ḥă·nup·pāh lə·ḵāl yā·ṣə·’āh hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: Therefore this is what the LORD of Hosts says concerning the prophets . . . I will feed them wormwood and give them poisoned water to drink for - from the prophets of Jerusalem ungodliness . . . has spread throughout the land

verses.original: כֹּֽה־ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֗וֹת אָמַ֞ר אַֽל־ תִּשְׁמְע֞וּ עַל־ דִּבְרֵ֤י הַנְּבִאִים֙ הַנִּבְּאִ֣ים לָכֶ֔ם מַהְבִּלִ֥ים הֵ֖מָּה אֶתְכֶ֑ם יְדַבֵּ֔רוּ חֲז֤וֹן לִבָּם֙ לֹ֖א מִפִּ֥י יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: kōh- Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ ’ā·mar ’al- tiš·mə·‘ū ‘al- diḇ·rê han·nə·ḇi·’îm han·nib·bə·’îm lā·ḵem mah·bi·lîm hêm·māh ’eṯ·ḵem yə·ḏab·bê·rū ḥă·zō·wn lib·bām lō mip·pî Yah·weh
verses.literal: This is what the LORD of Hosts says Do not listen to the words of the prophets who prophesy to you They are filling you with false hopes . . . - They speak visions from their own minds not from the mouth of the LORD

verses.original: אֹמְרִ֤ים אָמוֹר֙ לִֽמְנַאֲצַ֔י יְהוָ֔ה דִּבֶּ֣ר יִֽהְיֶ֣ה לָכֶ֑ם שָׁל֖וֹם אָֽמְר֔וּ וְ֠כֹל הֹלֵ֞ךְ בִּשְׁרִר֤וּת לִבּוֹ֙ לֹֽא־ רָעָֽה׃ תָב֥וֹא עֲלֵיכֶ֖ם
verses.transliteration: ’ō·mə·rîm ’ā·mō·wr lim·na·’ă·ṣay Yah·weh dib·ber yih·yeh lā·ḵem šā·lō·wm ’ā·mə·rū wə·ḵōl hō·lêḵ biš·ri·rūṯ lib·bōw lō- rā·‘āh ṯā·ḇō·w ‘ă·lê·ḵem
verses.literal: They keep saying . . . to those who despise Me The LORD says that you will have peace [and] to everyone who walks in the stubbornness of his own heart No harm will come to you

verses.original: כִּ֣י מִ֤י עָמַד֙ בְּס֣וֹד יְהוָ֔ה וְיֵ֖רֶא וְיִשְׁמַ֣ע אֶת־ דְּבָר֑וֹ מִֽי־ הִקְשִׁ֥יב דְּבָרִי וַיִּשְׁמָֽע׃ס
verses.transliteration: kî mî ‘ā·maḏ bə·sō·wḏ Yah·weh wə·yê·re wə·yiš·ma‘ ’eṯ- də·ḇā·rōw mî- hiq·šîḇ də·ḇå̄·rī way·yiš·mā‘
verses.literal: But which of them has stood in the council of the LORD to see and hear - His word Who has given heed to His word and obeyed it

verses.original: הִנֵּ֣ה׀ סַעֲרַ֣ת יְהוָ֗ה יָֽצְאָ֔ה חֵמָה֙ מִתְחוֹלֵ֑ל וְסַ֖עַר יָחֽוּל׃ עַ֛ל רֹ֥אשׁ רְשָׁעִ֖ים
verses.transliteration: hin·nêh sa·‘ă·raṯ Yah·weh yā·ṣə·’āh ḥê·māh miṯ·ḥō·w·lêl wə·sa·‘ar yā·ḥūl ‘al rōš rə·šā·‘îm
verses.literal: Behold the storm of the LORD has gone out with fury a whirlwind . . . swirling down upon the heads of the wicked

verses.original: אַף־ יְהוָ֔ה לֹ֤א יָשׁוּב֙ עַד־ עֲשֹׂת֥וֹ וְעַד־ הֲקִימ֖וֹ מְזִמּ֣וֹת לִבּ֑וֹ הַיָּמִ֔ים בְּאַֽחֲרִית֙ תִּתְבּ֥וֹנְנוּ בָ֖הּ בִּינָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ’ap̄- Yah·weh lō yā·šūḇ ‘aḏ- ‘ă·śō·ṯōw wə·‘aḏ- hă·qî·mōw mə·zim·mō·wṯ lib·bōw hay·yā·mîm bə·’a·ḥă·rîṯ tiṯ·bō·wn·nū ḇāh bî·nāh
verses.literal: The anger of the LORD will not turn back until He has fully accomplished . . . . . . the purposes of His heart In the days to come you will understand this clearly

verses.original: לֹא־ שָׁלַ֥חְתִּי אֶת־ הַנְּבִאִ֖ים וְהֵ֣ם רָ֑צוּ לֹא־ דִבַּ֥רְתִּי אֲלֵיהֶ֖ם וְהֵ֥ם נִבָּֽאוּ׃
verses.transliteration: lō- šā·laḥ·tî ’eṯ- han·nə·ḇi·’îm wə·hêm rā·ṣū lō- ḏib·bar·tî ’ă·lê·hem wə·hêm nib·bā·’ū
verses.literal: I did not send - these prophets yet they have run with their message I did not speak to them yet they have prophesied

verses.original: וְאִֽם־ עָמְד֖וּ בְּסוֹדִ֑י וְיַשְׁמִ֤עוּ דְבָרַי֙ אֶת־ עַמִּ֔י וִֽישִׁבוּם֙ הָרָ֔ע מִדַּרְכָּ֣ם וּמֵרֹ֖עַ מַֽעַלְלֵיהֶֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·’im- ‘ā·mə·ḏū bə·sō·w·ḏî wə·yaš·mi·‘ū ḏə·ḇā·ray ’eṯ- ‘am·mî wî·ši·ḇūm hā·rā‘ mid·dar·kām ū·mê·rō·a‘ ma·‘al·lê·hem
verses.literal: But if they had stood in My council they would have proclaimed My words - to My people and turned them back from their evil ways and deeds

verses.original: אָ֖נִי הַאֱלֹהֵ֧י מִקָּרֹ֛ב נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֑ה וְלֹ֥א אֱלֹהֵ֖י מֵרָחֹֽק׃
verses.transliteration: ’ā·nî ha·’ĕ·lō·hê miq·qā·rōḇ nə·’um- Yah·weh wə·lō ’ĕ·lō·hê mê·rā·ḥōq
verses.literal: Am I [only] a God nearby declares the LORD and not a God far away

verses.original: אִם־ אִ֧ישׁ יִסָּתֵ֨ר בַּמִּסְתָּרִ֛ים וַאֲנִ֥י לֹֽא־ אֶרְאֶ֖נּוּ נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֑ה אֲנִ֥י הֲל֨וֹא אֶת־ מָלֵ֖א הַשָּׁמַ֧יִם וְאֶת־ הָאָ֛רֶץ נְאֻם־ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ’im- ’îš yis·sā·ṯêr bam·mis·tā·rîm wa·’ă·nî lō- ’er·’en·nū nə·’um- Yah·weh ’ă·nî hă·lō·w ’eṯ- mā·lê haš·šā·ma·yim wə·’eṯ- hā·’ā·reṣ nə·’um- Yah·weh
verses.literal: Can a man hide in secret places where I cannot see him declares the LORD Do I not - fill the heavens and the earth declares the LORD

verses.original: שָׁמַ֗עְתִּי אֵ֤ת אָֽמְרוּ֙ אֲשֶׁר־ הַנְּבִאִ֔ים הַֽנִּבְּאִ֥ים שֶׁ֖קֶר לֵאמֹ֑ר בִּשְׁמִ֛י חָלַ֖מְתִּי חָלָֽמְתִּי׃
verses.transliteration: šā·ma‘·tî ’êṯ ’ā·mə·rū ’ă·šer- han·nə·ḇi·’îm han·nib·bə·’îm še·qer lê·mōr biš·mî ḥā·lam·tî ḥā·lā·mə·tî
verses.literal: I have heard - the sayings - of the prophets who prophesy lies . . . in My name I had a dream I had a dream

verses.original: עַד־ מָתַ֗י הֲיֵ֛שׁ בְּלֵ֥ב הַנְּבִאִ֖ים נִבְּאֵ֣י הַשָּׁ֑קֶר וּנְבִיאֵ֖י תַּרְמִ֥ת לִבָּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ‘aḏ- mā·ṯay hă·yêš bə·lêḇ han·nə·ḇi·’îm nib·bə·’ê haš·šā·qer ū·nə·ḇî·’ê tar·miṯ lib·bām
verses.literal: How long . . . will this continue in the hearts of these prophets who prophesy falsehood these prophets of the delusion of their own minds

verses.original: הַחֹשְׁבִ֗ים בַּחֲל֣וֹמֹתָ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר יְסַפְּר֖וּ אִ֣ישׁ לְרֵעֵ֑הוּ עַמִּי֙ לְהַשְׁכִּ֤יחַ אֶת־ שְׁמִ֔י כַּאֲשֶׁ֨ר אֲבוֹתָ֛ם אֶת־ שָׁכְח֧וּ שְׁמִ֖י בַּבָּֽעַל׃
verses.transliteration: ha·ḥō·šə·ḇîm ba·ḥă·lō·w·mō·ṯām ’ă·šer yə·sap·pə·rū ’îš lə·rê·‘ê·hū ‘am·mî lə·haš·kî·aḥ ’eṯ- šə·mî ka·’ă·šer ’ă·ḇō·w·ṯām ’eṯ- šā·ḵə·ḥū šə·mî bab·bā·‘al
verses.literal: They suppose the dreams that they tell one another {will make} My people forget - My name just as their fathers - forgot My name through the worship of Baal

verses.original: הַנָּבִ֞יא אֲשֶׁר־ אִתּ֤וֹ חֲלוֹם֙ יְסַפֵּ֣ר חֲל֔וֹם וַאֲשֶׁ֤ר אִתּ֔וֹ דְּבָרִי֙ יְדַבֵּ֥ר דְּבָרִ֖י אֱמֶ֑ת מַה־ לַתֶּ֥בֶן אֶת־ הַבָּ֖ר נְאֻם־ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: han·nā·ḇî ’ă·šer- ’it·tōw ḥă·lō·wm yə·sap·pêr ḥă·lō·wm wa·’ă·šer ’it·tōw də·ḇā·rî yə·ḏab·bêr də·ḇā·rî ’ĕ·meṯ mah- lat·te·ḇen ’eṯ- hab·bār nə·’um- Yah·weh
verses.literal: Let the prophet who has a dream retell [it] but let him who has My word speak [it] truthfully For what is straw compared to grain declares the LORD

verses.original: הֲל֨וֹא כֹ֧ה דְבָרִ֛י כָּאֵ֖שׁ נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֑ה וּכְפַטִּ֖ישׁ יְפֹ֥צֵֽץ סָֽלַע׃ס
verses.transliteration: hă·lō·w ḵōh ḏə·ḇā·rî kā·’êš nə·’um- Yah·weh ū·ḵə·p̄aṭ·ṭîš yə·p̄ō·ṣêṣ sā·la‘
verses.literal: Is not . . . My word like fire declares the LORD and like a hammer that smashes a rock

verses.original: לָכֵ֛ן הִנְנִ֥י נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֑ה עַל־ הַנְּבִאִ֖ים מְגַנְּבֵ֣י אִ֖ישׁ מֵאֵ֥ת רֵעֵֽהוּ׃ דְבָרַ֔י
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên hin·nî nə·’um- Yah·weh ‘al- han·nə·ḇi·’îm mə·ḡan·nə·ḇê ’îš mê·’êṯ rê·‘ê·hū ḏə·ḇā·ray
verses.literal: Therefore behold declares the LORD I am against the prophets who steal from one . . . another words [they attribute] to Me

verses.original: הִנְנִ֥י נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֑ה עַל־ הַנְּבִיאִ֖ם הַלֹּקְחִ֣ים לְשׁוֹנָ֔ם וַֽיִּנְאֲמ֖וּ נְאֻֽם׃
verses.transliteration: hin·nî nə·’um- Yah·weh ‘al- han·nə·ḇî·’im hal·lō·qə·ḥîm lə·šō·w·nām way·yin·’ă·mū nə·’um
verses.literal: Yes declares the LORD I am against the prophets who wag their own tongues and proclaim [The LORD] declares [it]

verses.original: הִ֠נְנִי נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֔ה עַֽל־ נִבְּאֵ֞י שֶׁ֙קֶר֙ חֲלֹמ֥וֹת וַֽיְסַפְּרוּם֙ עַמִּ֔י וַיַּתְע֣וּ אֶת־ וּבְפַחֲזוּתָ֑ם בְּשִׁקְרֵיהֶ֖ם לֹֽא־ וְאָנֹכִ֨י שְׁלַחְתִּ֜ים צִוִּיתִ֗ים וְלֹ֣א וְהוֹעֵ֛יל לֹֽא־ יוֹעִ֥ילוּ הַזֶּ֖ה לָֽעָם־ נְאֻם־ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: hin·nî nə·’um- Yah·weh ‘al- nib·bə·’ê še·qer ḥă·lō·mō·wṯ way·sap·pə·rūm ‘am·mî way·yaṯ·‘ū ’eṯ- ū·ḇə·p̄a·ḥă·zū·ṯām bə·šiq·rê·hem lō- wə·’ā·nō·ḵî šə·laḥ·tîm ṣiw·wî·ṯîm wə·lō wə·hō·w·‘êl lō- yō·w·‘î·lū haz·zeh lā·‘ām- nə·’um- Yah·weh
verses.literal: Indeed declares the LORD I am against those who prophesy false dreams and retell them to lead My people astray - with their reckless lies It was not I who sent them or commanded them and they are of no benefit . . . at all to these people declares the LORD

verses.original: וְכִי־ הַזֶּ֜ה הָעָ֨ם אֽוֹ־ הַנָּבִ֤יא אֽוֹ־ כֹהֵן֙ יִשְׁאָלְךָ֩ מַה־ מַשָּׂ֖א יְהוָ֑ה וְאָמַרְתָּ֤ לֵאמֹ֔ר אֲלֵיהֶם֙ אֶת־ מַה־ מַשָּׂ֔א וְנָטַשְׁתִּ֥י אֶתְכֶ֖ם נְאֻם־ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵî- haz·zeh hā·‘ām ’ōw- han·nā·ḇî ’ōw- ḵō·hên yiš·’ā·lə·ḵā mah- maś·śā Yah·weh wə·’ā·mar·tā lê·mōr ’ă·lê·hem ’eṯ- mah- maś·śā wə·nā·ṭaš·tî ’eṯ·ḵem nə·’um- Yah·weh
verses.literal: Now when this people or a prophet or priest asks you What is the burden of the LORD . . . you are to say to them - What burden I will forsake you declares the LORD

verses.original: וְהַנָּבִ֤יא וְהַכֹּהֵן֙ וְהָעָ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר יֹאמַ֖ר מַשָּׂ֣א יְהוָ֑ה וּפָקַדְתִּ֛י עַל־ הַה֖וּא וְעַל־ הָאִ֥ישׁ בֵּיתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·han·nā·ḇî wə·hak·kō·hên wə·hā·‘ām ’ă·šer yō·mar maś·śā Yah·weh ū·p̄ā·qaḏ·tî ‘al- ha·hū wə·‘al- hā·’îš bê·ṯōw
verses.literal: As for the prophet [or] priest [or] anyone who claims This is the burden of the LORD I will punish . . . that . . . man and his household

verses.original: כֹּ֥ה אִ֥ישׁ תֹאמְר֛וּ עַל־ רֵעֵ֖הוּ וְאִ֣ישׁ אֶל־ אָחִ֑יו מֶה־ יְהוָ֔ה עָנָ֣ה וּמַה־ יְהוָֽה׃ דִּבֶּ֖ר
verses.transliteration: kōh ’îš ṯō·mə·rū ‘al- rê·‘ê·hū wə·’îš ’el- ’ā·ḥîw meh- Yah·weh ‘ā·nāh ū·mah- Yah·weh dib·ber
verses.literal: This is what each man is to say to his friend . . . and to his brother What has the LORD answered or ‘What has the LORD spoken

verses.original: תִזְכְּרוּ־ לֹ֣א ע֑וֹד וּמַשָּׂ֥א יְהוָ֖ה כִּ֣י לְאִ֣ישׁ דְּבָר֔וֹ יִֽהְיֶה֙ הַמַּשָּׂ֗א וַהֲפַכְתֶּ֗ם אֶת־ דִּבְרֵי֙ חַיִּ֔ים אֱלֹהִ֣ים יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ṯiz·kə·rū- lō ‘ō·wḏ ū·maś·śā Yah·weh kî lə·’îš də·ḇā·rōw yih·yeh ham·maś·śā wa·hă·p̄aḵ·tem ’eṯ- diḇ·rê ḥay·yîm ’ĕ·lō·hîm Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ ’ĕ·lō·hê·nū
verses.literal: But refer no more to the burden of the LORD for each man’s word becomes the burden so that you pervert - the words of the living God the LORD of Hosts our God

verses.original: כֹּ֥ה תֹאמַ֖ר אֶל־ הַנָּבִ֑יא מֶה־ יְהוָ֔ה עָנָ֣ךְ וּמַה־ יְהוָֽה׃ דִּבֶּ֖ר
verses.transliteration: kōh ṯō·mar ’el- han·nā·ḇî meh- Yah·weh ‘ā·nāḵ ū·mah- Yah·weh dib·ber
verses.literal: Thus you are to say to the prophet What has the LORD answered you and ‘What has the LORD spoken

verses.original: וְאִם־ תֹּאמֵרוּ֒ מַשָּׂ֣א יְהוָה֮ לָכֵ֗ן כֹּ֚ה יְהוָ֔ה אָמַ֣ר יַ֧עַן אֲמָרְכֶ֛ם אֶת־ הַדָּבָ֥ר הַזֶּ֖ה מַשָּׂ֣א יְהוָ֑ה וָאֶשְׁלַ֤ח אֲלֵיכֶם֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר לֹ֥א תֹאמְר֖וּ מַשָּׂ֥א יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’im- tō·mê·rū maś·śā Yah·weh lā·ḵên kōh Yah·weh ’ā·mar ya·‘an ’ă·mā·rə·ḵem ’eṯ- had·dā·ḇār haz·zeh maś·śā Yah·weh wā·’eš·laḥ ’ă·lê·ḵem lê·mōr lō ṯō·mə·rū maś·śā Yah·weh
verses.literal: But if you claim This is the burden of the LORD then this is what the LORD says Because you have said - - . . . This is the burden of the LORD and I specifically told . . . . . . you not to make this claim - -

verses.original: לָכֵ֣ן הִנְנִ֔י וְנָשִׁ֥יתִי אֶתְכֶ֖ם נָשֹׁ֑א וְנָטַשְׁתִּ֣י מֵעַ֥ל פָּנָֽי׃ אֶתְכֶ֗ם וְאֶת־ הָעִיר֙ אֲשֶׁ֨ר נָתַ֧תִּי לָכֶ֛ם וְלַאֲבוֹתֵיכֶ֖ם
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên hin·nî wə·nā·šî·ṯî ’eṯ·ḵem nā·šō wə·nā·ṭaš·tî mê·‘al pā·nāy ’eṯ·ḵem wə·’eṯ- hā·‘îr ’ă·šer nā·ṯat·tî lā·ḵem wə·la·’ă·ḇō·w·ṯê·ḵem
verses.literal: therefore I will surely forget you vvv and will cast you out of My presence both you and the city that I gave to you and your fathers

verses.original: וְנָתַתִּ֥י עֲלֵיכֶ֖ם עוֹלָ֑ם חֶרְפַּ֣ת עוֹלָ֔ם וּכְלִמּ֣וּת אֲשֶׁ֖ר לֹ֥א תִשָּׁכֵֽחַ׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·nā·ṯat·tî ‘ă·lê·ḵem ‘ō·w·lām ḥer·paṯ ‘ō·w·lām ū·ḵə·lim·mūṯ ’ă·šer lō ṯiš·šā·ḵê·aḥ
verses.literal: And I will bring upon you everlasting shame and perpetual humiliation that will never be forgotten
